content.name: Tobias Nguyen
content.title: Lead Digital Marketing Specialist
content.summary: Digital marketing specialist with 16 years in Berlin, from an IHK apprenticeship to leading performance marketing for a green energy supplier. Manages €3.6m in annual media across search, social and comparison portals and rebuilt tracking under TTDSG consent rules without losing conversion visibility.

experience.title: Lead Digital Marketing Specialist
bullets: Lead a team of four running search, social, affiliate and comparison-portal acquisition for a renewable electricity and gas supplier, with €3.6m annual media.
Brought customer acquisition cost down from €96 to €71 per contract by moving budget from portals to search and tightening portal bonus rules.
Rebuilt consent and tracking with the data protection officer under GDPR and TTDSG, using server-side tagging to restore 85% of measurable conversions.
Launched a heat-pump tariff campaign in six federal states that signed 4,800 contracts in its first winter.

experience.title: Senior Digital Marketing Specialist
bullets: Managed paid search and metasearch for a city-break and rail travel operator in German, English and Dutch markets.
Steered the business through the 2020 travel collapse by pausing 80% of spend within 48 hours and redirecting budget to flexible-booking offers.
Recovered bookings to 112% of 2019 levels by summer 2022 using value-based bidding and new last-minute landing pages.
Coached three junior colleagues and introduced a monthly test review that kept results documented in one shared log.

experience.title: SEA Team Lead
bullets: Led a team of six SEA managers handling 30 client accounts with combined spend of €1.4m a month.
Won four new retail clients by presenting feed optimisation audits during the pitch.
Created a reporting template in Google Data Studio that cut month-end reporting time by half across the team.

experience.title: Online Marketing Manager
bullets: Built the online shop's first Google Shopping and newsletter programmes after completing my apprenticeship.
Grew online revenue from €1.9m to €5.3m over three years through search, newsletters and marketplace listings.
Coordinated product photography and descriptions for 2,500 furniture items with the warehouse team.

education.degree: Kaufmann für Marketingkommunikation (IHK), apprenticeship in marketing communications
